drawer_front: visible movable drawer front panel INCLUDING attached pull handle, EXCLUDING cavity floor/interior, side panels, cabinet face/doors; box tight to visible front-panel-plus-handle extent; no hidden/amodal completion
gripper_finger: one box per visibly identifiable mechanical finger distal to main palm (up to2); include finger body/tip, exclude palm/wrist/arm and held object; same unordered class, no physical left/right ID
unknown: no box when cannot identify/bound visible target; ignore uncertain class-image in training/scoring, report its prediction rate separately
coordinates: integer RGB xyxy pixels, exclusive upper bounds; drawn after actually viewing RGB only
annotator: assistant visual annotation, reviewed overlays, not independent human gold standard
